description: Use this when the user describes a product and wants its US HTS code, tariff classification or import duty ("HTS code for…", "tariff on … from China", "import duty for …"). Searches the official US Harmonized Tariff Schedule by keywords and returns the best matching codes with rates and Section 301 China status. Then use lookup_hts for full detail on one code.

query.description: Product words, e.g. "stainless steel kitchen sink"

name: search_hts
title: Find HTS codes by product
